title: WHOSE DELTA?
sub: For centuries, Khmer communities lived across much of the Mekong Delta. Today, the delta is the heart of southern Vietnam. How did that happen?
say: For centuries, Kmeyr communities lived across much of the Mekong Delta. Today, the delta is the heart of southern Vietnam. How did that happen?

title: PREY NOKOR
sub: Before Saigon, Prey Nokor was a small Khmer settlement near today's Ho Chi Minh City.
say: Before Saigon, Pray No-kor was a small Kmeyr settlement near today's Ho Chee Min City.

title: SETTLERS
sub: In the 1600s, Vietnamese settlers moved into parts of the delta. A royal marriage between the Nguyễn and Cambodia's court is traditionally linked to these ties.
say: In the sixteen hundreds, Vietnamese settlers moved into parts of the delta. A royal marriage between the Nwin and Cambodia's court is traditionally linked to these ties.

title: MING REFUGEES
sub: In 1679, commanders and followers described as Ming loyalists arrived from China. Nguyễn authorities settled them at Mỹ Tho and Biên Hòa.
say: In sixteen seventy-nine, commanders and followers described as Ming loyalists arrived from China. Nwin authorities settled them at Mee Toh and Bee-en Hwah.

sub: In 1698, Nguyễn Hữu Cảnh organized Nguyễn administration around Gia Định.
say: In sixteen ninety-eight, Nwin Hoo Kahn organized Nwin administration around Zah Din.

title: HÀ TIÊN
sub: Farther west, Mạc Cửu helped develop Hà Tiên into a port. He later accepted Nguyễn overlordship while keeping local authority.
say: Farther west, Mahk Koo helped develop Hah Tee-en into a port. He later accepted Nwin overlordship while keeping local authority.

title: WAR AND DIPLOMACY
sub: In the 1700s, migration, Nguyễn intervention in Cambodian succession disputes, and warfare changed control in parts of the delta.
say: In the seventeen hundreds, migration, Nwin intervention in Cambodian succession disputes, and warfare changed control in parts of the delta.

title: 1830s
sub: In the 1830s, Minh Mạng's government brought Cambodia under direct rule. Cambodian resistance and Siamese intervention helped force a Vietnamese withdrawal in the 1840s.
say: In the eighteen thirties, Min Mahng's government brought Cambodia under direct rule. Cambodian resistance and Siamese intervention helped force a Vietnamese withdrawal in the eighteen forties.

title: TODAY
sub: Vietnam's 2019 census counted 1,319,652 Khmer people, most living in the Mekong Delta. In Khmer, the region is called Kampuchea Krom, Lower Cambodia.
say: Vietnam's twenty nineteen census counted one million, three hundred and nineteen thousand, six hundred and fifty-two Kmeyr people, most living in the Mekong Delta. In Kmeyr, the region is called Kahm-poo-chee-ah Krom, Lower Cambodia.

title: RICE & EMPIRES
sub: Borders feel permanent. They rarely are. Follow for more.
say: Borders feel permanent. They rarely are. Follow for more.
